# SOP-01: Reordering from the distributor

## Purpose

Reorders go to the distributor as one list, entered on one form instead of on paper. [quick-scope.md WP-2]

## Who does what

| role | does |
|---|---|
| shop manager | fills the reorder form and sends the list |

## When

Whenever stock runs low, and at least every Friday. [user-stated 2026-12-14]

## Steps

1. Fill the reorder form with each title and quantity (software step: see the Shop manager guide, "Send a reorder to the distributor"). [SC-03 step 1]
2. Send the list to the distributor the same day. [user-stated 2026-12-14]

## Exceptions and who handles them

A title the distributor no longer stocks is crossed off the list and noted for the next order. [user-stated 2026-12-14]

## Escalation

The owner, for an order over the usual weekly amount. [user-stated 2026-12-14]

## Records kept

Sent lists stay in the shop's email. The client has not said how long these are kept; ask before setting a period.

## Review

Review this procedure by 16 August 2027, or sooner when the process changes. [user-stated 2026-12-14]
